description: Localized in-battle UI strings: HUD and marker labels, button guides, result/evaluation labels, overlay text and mission-task progress text, stored as generic GameText rows.

ID.simple: Battle UI text id (row key), e.g. BTL_HUD_LABEL_0001.
ID.technical: FName ID in FGameDataTableRow_GameText, stored next to the row name and used as the lookup key in the ordered 14-table GameText array. The localized asset is BattleTextDataTable_<EApplicationLanguage name>, loaded via primary asset id DataTable. Consumers set these ids on IGameWidgetTextSettingInterface text blocks or pass them to GetText; maps such as GBattleResultLabel11Map map ranks/results/characters to literal BTL_RESULT_LABEL_* ids. No prefix-based dispatch exists: any non-SYS_ id is searched from slot 1 (Glossary) onward, with BattleText at slot 2.

Text.simple: The localized label/format string shown in the battle UI.
Text.technical: FString row text (+0x10), copied out of the table by GetGameText and passed through AGameTextManager::FormatText. This group uses markup heavily in the export: <DYN=HIT_POINT>/<DYN=HIT_POINT_MAX>, <DYN=VALUE>/<DYN=MAX_VALUE> and <GLO=...> placeholders are replaced from the request parameter map and from the glossary map built from GlossaryTextDataTable_<Language>; [ABS], [RATE_TO_PCT], [FULL_WIDTH], [HALF_WIDTH], [DECIMAL_PLACE_n] are recognized modifier tokens. Missing rows or empty strings yield empty text. Text blocks with bForceOneLine collapse newlines (no separator for Ja/Zh_Hant/Zh_Hans, otherwise a space). Three En rows in the companion export are empty, and HasGameTextContent checks for that case.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_GameText is used for all 11 exported language variants; their row sets are identical (728 ids each in the companion export). Loaded as slot 2 of the GameText table array; Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 puts each TextDataTable_<Lang> variant in its own always-cooked chunk.

Observed consumer families: BTL_HUD_LABEL_* for HP/time/cursed-energy/combo/adapt icons; BTL_MARKER_LABEL_0001 for player-index markers; BTL_OVERLAY_LABEL_* for win/lose overlays; BTL_MISSION_TASK_LABEL_0001 with DYN=VALUE/MAX_VALUE parameters; BTL_RESULT_LABEL_* literal maps for result screens. GameBattleCursedEnergyLevelWidget formats ids dynamically as BTL_HUD_LABEL_01%02d from the energy level.

Glossary values can be nested in battle text via <GLO=...>; the glossary map is rebuilt from GlossaryTextDataTable_<Language> in the same Tick before OnCultureTextLoaded broadcasts (GameTextManager.cpp:571-577). DYN values come from the caller's FGameTextParameterMap, not from the table.

Reconstruction caveat: byte-matched GetGameText/FormatText vs behaviour-certified FindTextRow/Tick (status/functions.json 0x14af290, 0x14af510, 0x14c4870, 0x14c96f0; BG03 record). Content is partial; additional Blueprint-only uses cannot be ruled out or claimed.

usages.detail: Sets the HP text block to BTL_HUD_LABEL_0001 with HIT_POINT/HIT_POINT_MAX parameters.
Uses BTL_HUD_LABEL_0301 for the remaining-time label and BTL_HUD_LABEL_0302 when time expires.
Selects BTL_HUD_LABEL_061x/062x/063x guide ids by gauge/button state.
Picks BTL_OVERLAY_LABEL_* ids for win/lose/result overlays and level-sequence overlays.
GBattleResultLabel11Map maps result rank indices 1..34 to BTL_RESULT_LABEL_11xx ids; used by GameResultScoreListItemWidget.cpp:25-36.
Builds VALUE/MAX_VALUE int parameters for the BTL_MISSION_TASK_LABEL_0001 formatting template.
